description: The day's fixed sample of up to 20 single-word names at auction, by deadline. Use it when someone asks what is at auction today or wants auction names to look at. A fixed daily sample of single-word names, not every auction. Its one input, `fields`, is optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: name, ending, venue, venueLabel, endsAt, currency, bid, bidCount, verdict, firstYear, tag.
